title: Incident FR-0153: BlackBox Provider v2 Behavioral Changes

changes.v2: saldo returns two-decimal monetary string representation of cents (e.g. '0.00')
changes.verification: ALTA initial balance returns '0.00'; DEPOSITO of 1000 cents returns '10.00'
TRANSFER 50000 returns 200; TRANSFER 50001 returns 422 E506 'límite excedido'
When account balance is 0 and transfer is 60000 (>50000 limit and >0 balance), v2 responds with 422 E506 'límite excedido' instead of E507
